parameters.query:
INSERT INTO solution_suggestions (base_solution_id, title_th, title_en, description_th, description_en, rationale, features, content_ai, status)
VALUES (
  $1, $2, $3, $4, $5, $6,
  $7::jsonb, $8::jsonb,
  'pending_review'
)
RETURNING *;

UPDATE solution_suggestions
SET status = 'publishing', reviewed_at = NOW(), error_message = NULL
WHERE id = $1 AND status IN ('pending_review', 'failed')
RETURNING *;

UPDATE solution_suggestions
SET status = 'published_as_draft', published_solution_id = $1, published_at = NOW(), error_message = NULL
WHERE id = $2
RETURNING *;

parameters.responseBody: ={{ { success: true, message: 'Published as draft on SyaCo', solutionId: $json.id } }}

parameters.query:
UPDATE solution_suggestions
SET status = 'failed', error_message = $1
WHERE id = $2
RETURNING *;

options.queryReplacement: ={{ [String($json.message || $json.error || 'Failed to create solution on SyaCo API'), $('Build SyaCo Payload (Draft Mode)').first().json.suggestionId] }}

parameters.responseBody: ={{ { success: false, error: $json.error_message || 'Failed to publish draft' } }}
